visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tinted panel row pairing a feature label with its description; explainer pairs heading + text with an illustration, award/awards show a label beside logo + caption items

contentPattern.structure: One row per feature. First text cell: the label (or heading + text for explainer). Following cells: description (text, links, info button), a picture-only illustration/logo, or a media item (logo picture plus bold title and caption, laid out side by side). A single-cell row spans the full width. Empty cells are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use for label/description feature rows, single explainer panels with an illustration, and award strips. Use columns-promo for image + CTA promos and table-striped for multi-column data. Colour options (alt, light) are styled in the design pass
